Messages.Body:
There is current errata that Allies ignore "burn blood" effects entirely.
Does that infer that if a vampire attempts to steal blood from an ally,
it will have no effect since allies have life, not blood?

Noal

Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
In article <75ee89$h73$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>, <Dhar...@yahoo.com> wrote:
>There is current errata that Allies ignore "burn blood" effects entirely.
>Does that infer that if a vampire attempts to steal blood from an ally,
>it will have no effect since allies have life, not blood?

No. From the revised rules, section 6.4.5 Strike Effects:
"Steal Blood. This effect moves blood counters (or life counters) from the
target to the striking minion."

--
Justin Fang (jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu)
